Contemporaneous Record

Selected archival mastheads and publication records documenting Mike Ye’s role as Vice President, Strategic Planning & Acquisitions at Penske Media Corporation across multiple publications and years.

During his tenure at Penske Media Corporation, Mike Ye was identified in mastheads across PMC publications as Vice President, Strategic Planning & Acquisitions. The records below provide contemporaneous documentation of that title, employer relationship, and continuity across PMC’s media portfolio.

This page is a selected evidentiary record rather than a comprehensive archive. The examples span multiple publications and years to document continuity across entertainment, music, fashion, luxury, and art media.
